module: Transactional model of the multi-seat configuration: which input devices (or platform-managed device groups) belong to which player/persona. begin() opens a transaction (copy of the current state or of the assignment cache), the editing functions modify it, getPreview() provides the state to the UI, then commit() (or commitCore + completeCommit) applies it via core_multiseat.applyConfiguration; discard() abandons it. Used by the multiseat settings screen.
usage:
local cfg = require('ge/extensions/ui/multiseat/multiseatConfiguration')
cfg.begin({source = 'settings'})
cfg.setDevicePlayer('keyboard-mouse', 1)
local ok, configOrReason = cfg.commit()
notes: All editing functions return false when no transaction is open (except getPreview, which calls begin() automatically).

The functions toggleDevicePlayer, setDevicePlayer, removeDevice, moveDevicePlayer and cycleDevicePlayer only work in manual mode (platformManagesPlayers == false); joinDeviceGroup only in platform mode.
The number of personas is limited to MAX_PLAYERS = 64 and by the hard limit of the current gamemode (core/multiseatPlayerLimits).
Persona numbers start at 1; the player index (player) starts at 0 and follows the ascending order of persona numbers.
A persona with no owner (no device/group) is automatically deleted.

When there is no active multiseat session, begin() takes player 0's vehicle (except unicycle) for persona 1 and tries to reuse the assignment cache (core_multiseat.getCachedPlayerAssignments) if the platform mode has not changed.
Each modification triggers guihooks MultiseatConfigurationChanged with an increasing revision number and updates the device color preview.
commitCore refuses a configuration with no player (reason "no_players").

AUTOMATIC_COLOR_DEFAULT.desc: Default value (true) of the multiseatAutomaticColor setting.

begin.desc: Opens the configuration transaction if it does not exist (copy of the active configuration or of the cache), otherwise reconciles the device inventory. Calls core_multiseat.beginConfigurationEdit.

options.desc: Options; source = origin of the opening (for example "settings").

isActive.desc: Returns whether a transaction is open.

discard.desc: Abandons the transaction; if it had already been applied (commitCore), restores the starting configuration. Ends the edit on the core_multiseat side.

returns.desc: false if there was no transaction.

toggleDevicePlayer.desc: Manual mode: removes the device from its player if it has one, otherwise assigns it to the first free persona.

setDevicePlayer.desc: Manual mode: assigns the device to the given persona (1 to 64), or unassigns it with nil or 0. Returns false if nothing changes or the player limit forbids it.

personaNumber.desc: 1..64 to assign, nil or 0 to unassign.

removeDevice.desc: Manual mode: forgets a disconnected device (connected == false), unassigns it and marks it as removed.

returns.desc: false if the device is not found or still connected.

moveDevicePlayer.desc: Manual mode: moves the device to the previous persona (direction -1, or none if it is the first) or the next one (direction 1, or a new persona if it is the last and it has several devices).

cycleDevicePlayer.desc: Manual mode: with no player, assigns the device to the first free persona; otherwise moves it to the previous persona (or unassigns it if there is none).

joinDeviceGroup.desc: Platform mode: makes a device group join; the persona takes the group's number if it is free and valid, otherwise the first free one.

returns.desc: false if already joined or limit reached.

leavePlayer.desc: Removes a player: frees all its devices/groups and deletes its persona.

returns.desc: false if the player does not exist.

setPersonaData.desc: Copies the keys of data into the persona (name, icon, color, vehicle...).

emitChange.desc: If false, does not notify the UI.

returns.desc: false if no transaction, invalid data or unknown persona.

getPersona.desc: Returns a copy of the transaction's persona.

getPreview.desc: Returns the displayable state of the configuration (opens the transaction if needed): availablePlayers (devices in manual mode), availablePersonas and joinedPersonas, deviceGroups (platform mode), maxPlayers, platformManagesPlayers, playerLimit {limit, hard, atLimit, exceeded} and revision.

getPlayers.desc: Returns the list of player indices (0 to n-1).

getCommitConfiguration.desc: Builds the configuration to apply: platformManagesPlayers, personaOptInMode, manualAssignments (deviceId to player, -1 if none), manualDeviceMetadata, groupAssignments, platformDeviceGroups, participants {playerIndex, personaNumber, persona} and adoptVehicleId.

hasUserChanges.desc: Returns whether the user has modified the assignments since opening (or whether they come from the cache).

clearCachedAssignments.desc: Clears the player assignment cache (core_multiseat.cachePlayerAssignments with empty lists). No effect if multiseat is already active.

returns.desc: Result of the clearing, false if impossible.

hasChanges.desc: Compares the current configuration to the starting baseline: true if multiseat was not active, or if the number of players or the assignments differ.

commitCore.desc: Applies the configuration via core_multiseat.applyConfiguration (participant notification deferred) and stores the change log; the transaction stays open to allow rollbackCommit.

returns.desc: Applied configuration, or failure reason (for example "no_players").

completeCommit.desc: Ends a successful commit: calls core_multiseat.finalizeConfiguration, closes the transaction and logs the changes.

rollbackCommit.desc: Restores the starting configuration after a commitCore.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the level; abandons the transaction without restoring and clears the color preview.

onInputBindingsChanged.desc: Hook called when devices or bindings change; reconciles the inventory and notifies the UI if the list changed.
